In particular $G(s)\ge 7$ for all admissible $s$, and combined with $A(c)\ge\frac{13}{7}$ we obtain

$$E=G(s)\cdot A(c)\ge 7\cdot\frac{13}{7}=13.$$

The constraint $x+y+c>\sqrt{13}$ is satisfied at the critical configuration ($s\approx2.076$, $c=\sqrt3$, sum $\approx3.81>\sqrt{13}$), so the bound is valid over the feasible region.
